motion.name: standard
motion.purpose: Quiet state transitions on compact controls.

narrative.overview: The builder is a calm and precise control room for making visual decisions. It places a focused editing surface beside a realistic preview, using layered pale surfaces and quiet borders to keep attention on the theme rather than on decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Layered white work areas over a pale green-gray shell.
Muted Filament teal for active and actionable states.
Compact, expert-oriented controls with clear focus treatment.

rules.name: The Rare Accent Rule
rules.body: Filament teal should identify action and active state, not become a decorative fill across the whole workspace.

rules.name: The Border-First Rule
rules.body: Use a clear structural divider before adding visual elevation.

dos: Do keep the editor and preview visibly connected through shared surfaces and border rhythm.
Do use Filament teal to make active and actionable states easy to scan.
Do preserve keyboard focus visibility with the amber outline.
Do let responsive layout move the preview above the controls on narrow screens.
donts: Don't add gradients, oversized hero treatments, or ornamental dashboard cards.
Don't replace clear borders with shadows as the default depth cue.
Don't make the accent color compete with the editable theme preview.
